source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on phase 2 of the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 15
statement: A document's revision index and the app list are ignorable with must-understand (SNP-27, SNP-28): read alike by both versions' control stores, rewritten unchanged, a later member dropped by a rewrite that leaves the same record, and a record whose crit names a member a version does not know refused by it and never rewritten.
guards: compat:ControlStoreCompatTest#each version reads the record alike, and reads it again after the other rewrote it
compat:ControlStoreCompatTest#a later member without crit is dropped by a rewrite, which leaves the same record
compat:ControlStoreCompatTest#a record whose crit names a member a version does not know is refused by it, and never rewritten
